name: purchase_orders
_comment_purpose: An approved purchase order: what the company agreed to buy, from whom, for how much. review_invoice matches an invoice to its PO by `po_number` and compares the invoice total to the remaining balance (`amount_usd` - `billed_to_date_usd`). decide_invoice adds an approved invoice's total to `billed_to_date_usd`. `description` is the scope the invoice-reviewer subagent judges line items against.
